prompt: An enterprise has dashboards for its agents but incidents go unaddressed because nobody knows who owns them, and metrics are defined differently per team. Which component of the monitoring operating model in the learning content is missing?

More GPU capacity for the agents' models and a higher token budget, so that latency-related incidents disappear
A larger prompt library with more templates and a prompt-review board, so that output quality incidents are reduced over time
Replacing Azure Monitor with a shared spreadsheet so that each team records incidents in the same place

explanation: Das Monitoring Operating Model umfasst definierte Rollen (Ops, Product Owner, Data Engineers, Architekten), Incident-Response-Workflows, standardisierte Metriken mit Baseline, Log-Review-Kadenz, Change Management/Versionierung und dokumentierte Erwartungen an Agentenverhalten.

GPU utilization graphs and connector latency charts, which show whether slow responses are driving users away

That the guardrails are temporarily disabled during a measurement window to capture the agent's raw performance

prompt: An agent's logic has not changed, yet recurring tasks show declining accuracy and more off-topic responses over several weeks. Which phenomenon does the learning content describe, and what should be monitored?

options.text: Model drift, indicated by shifts in response patterns, declining accuracy in recurring tasks, and more hallucination
Connector throttling, indicated by HTTP 429 responses, rising latency, and failed tool invocations in the run logs of the agent
License exhaustion, indicated by blocked sessions, capacity warnings in the admin center, and shorter conversations
DLP enforcement, indicated by blocked connectors, policy alerts, and fallback responses when actions are denied

explanation: Auch bei stabiler Agentenlogik kann modellgetriebenes Verhalten driften: veränderte Antwortmuster, sinkende Genauigkeit bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben, mehr Halluzinationen oder Off-Topic. Zusätzlich Token-Verbrauch und Reliability-Indikatoren beobachten.

Generative agents are not testable before production, because their behavior is defined by the model vendor
Regression suites are valid for Power Automate flows and topics, but agents are validated by user feedback alone
Agents are tested by the model vendor, and the organization is responsible for the CRM logic and the data

prompt: A custom model's validation report shows 92 percent accuracy, a 5 percent incorrect-information rate, zero guardrail violations, and 1.8-second latency. Against the example validation metrics in the learning content, which criterion fails?

options.text: The incorrect-information rate, which should be at most 3 percent
Accuracy, which should be at least 95 percent correctness
Latency, which should stay below 1 second at the 95th percentile
Guardrail violations, which may be up to 2 per evaluation run

explanation: Beispiel-Schwellen: Latenz < 2 Sekunden, Throughput p95 stabil, Accuracy ≥ 90 %, Incorrect Information Rate ≤ 3 %, Guardrail Violations 0, Sensitive Output Detection 100 % blockiert, Token-Nutzung auf Baseline-Niveau, Satisfaction ≥ 4,5/5.

Throughput and token efficiency under peak load conditions

Scalability and resilience of the integration

Does the prompt stay under the recommended 500 words?

source.title: Validate effective Copilot prompt best practices

prompt: Two candidate prompts for an executive-summary task differ only in whether they add a "what not to include" exclusion list. Which validation method does the learning content recommend to decide between them, and what should be compared?

options.text: A/B prompt testing comparing output accuracy, clarity, relevance, and required follow-up prompts
Load testing comparing throughput and latency of both prompts at peak concurrency
Red teaming comparing jailbreak resistance of both prompts against adversarial inputs and injections
A user poll in which executives vote on which prompt reads better in the summary

explanation: A/B Prompt Testing vergleicht zwei Varianten nach Genauigkeit, Klarheit, Relevanz und nötigen Folge-Prompts; ergänzend Szenario-Tests über Nutzertypen und eine strukturierte Checkliste.

source.title: Validate effective Copilot prompt best practices

prompt: An AI-assisted order-to-cash process spans Dynamics 365 Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain. The test lead proposes validating each app's AI feature in isolation. What does the learning content require instead?

options.text: Validate the entire business process end to end, including data sync, automations, connectors, security roles, and AI actions
Test the Sales app alone, because the lead is created there and the downstream apps inherit the validated data
Skip integration testing, because the Dynamics 365 apps share one Dataverse database and sync does not fail
Test the AI prediction service alone, because the apps are Microsoft-maintained and covered by the vendor's regression suite

explanation: E2E-Tests validieren den gesamten Prozess (z. B. Order-to-Cash, Case-to-Resolution), nicht einzelne Module: Datensync über Entitäten, Automationen, Connectors, Sicherheitsrollen, AI-Aktionen, Ausnahmepfade und Post-Condition-Validierung.

source.title: Design end-to-end test scenarios for AI solutions using multiple Dynamics 365 apps
source.quote: Testing must validate the entire business process, not the individual modules alone.

prompt: A tester designs an E2E scenario for a multi-app AI solution. Evaluate each statement against the learning content.

statements.text: The scenario should include preconditions, step-by-step execution, the AI action triggered, cross-app data movement, post-condition validation, and exception paths.
Non-functional validation includes latency across apps and failure recovery.
Negative tests are unnecessary because AI handles unexpected inputs automatically.
Only structured data scenarios need to be covered; unstructured data is out of scope.

explanation: Die Szenariostruktur umfasst Preconditions, Schritte, AI-Aktion, Cross-App-Datenbewegung, Post-Condition und Exception/Negative Tests; Non-functional: Latenz, Fehlerbehandlung, Konsistenz. Best Practices: strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten, Normal- und Stresslast, regulatorische Constraints.

source.title: Design end-to-end test scenarios for AI solutions using multiple Dynamics 365 apps
source.quote: Include both structured and unstructured data scenarios.

prompt: Copilot-generated test cases vary wildly in format and omit boundary conditions. Which remedy does the learning content prescribe?

options.text: Provide a test case template in the prompt with test ID, purpose, preconditions, inputs, steps, expected results, edge cases, and dependencies
Ask Copilot to generate tests without any constraints or template, so that it can propose more creative scenarios and unusual edge cases on its own
Stop using Copilot for test generation and write each case manually, because generated cases are hard to validate for completeness
Generate the tests after the production deployment, so that Copilot can base them on real transcripts instead of requirements

explanation: Copilot arbeitet am besten mit konsistenten Mustern; der Blueprint (Test ID, Purpose, Preconditions, Inputs, Steps, Expected Results, Edge Case Variations, Dependencies) im Prompt liefert vorhersehbare, hochwertige Testfälle. Dazu Prompts mit Goal, Context, Constraints und Quality Expectations.

source.title: Build a strategy for creating test cases using Copilot
source.quote: Providing this template in the prompt ensures Copilot outputs predictable, high-quality test cases.

prompt: A team wants Copilot-generated test cases to stay current as requirements change across releases. Which practices does the learning content list for automating and scaling the strategy?

options.text: Maintain a reusable prompt library, version prompts and templates, integrate Copilot output into CI/CD, and regenerate tests on regression triggers
Regenerate the complete test set manually once a year during the annual release, and archive the previous set for audit purposes
Store the prompts in chat history and rely on Copilot's memory of previous sessions to keep the generated tests consistent across releases
Disable regression testing, because generated test cases are self-updating whenever the underlying requirements change

explanation: Skalierung: wiederverwendbare Prompt-Bibliothek, Versionskontrolle für Prompts und Templates, Integration in CI/CD, Regression-Trigger für Neugenerierung. Die Reifeleiter reicht von Ad-hoc-Prompting bis zur unternehmensweiten Prompt-Governance.

source.title: Build a strategy for creating test cases using Copilot
source.quote: Use regression triggers to request Copilot to generate updated tests when requirements change.

prompt: Which four review dimensions does the learning content give for validating Copilot-generated test cases?

options.text: Completeness, accuracy, clarity, and maintainability
Cost, latency, throughput, and drift indicators
Fairness, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability
Build, buy, extend, and retire decision criteria

explanation: Review: Completeness (alle Akzeptanzkriterien, Workflows, Grenz-/Fehlerfälle), Accuracy (Logik entspricht Regeln, gültige Preconditions), Clarity (ausführbare Schritte, messbare Ergebnisse), Maintainability (wiederverwendbar, konsistente Namen).
